Qasam hai ek pehar chadhe din ki
Aur qasam hai raat ki jab woh cheezon ki parda poshi kare
Tumhaare Parwardigar ne na tum ko chhoda hai aur na tum se naaraaz hua hai
Aur aakhirat tumhaare liye duniya se kahin zyaada behtar hai
Aur anqareeb tumhaara Parwardigar tumhein is qadr ata kar de ga ke khush ho jaao
Kya us ne tum ko yateem paa kar panaah nahin di hai
Aur kya tum ko gum-gashta paa kar manzil tak nahin pahunchaaya hai
Aur tum ko tang-dast paa kar ghani nahin banaaya hai
Lehaaza ab tum yateem par qahar na karna
Aur saail ko jhidak mat dena
Aur apne Parwardigar ki ne'maton ko baraabar bayaan karte rehna
